name: Elven Trip
source: She had to see the statue again, she had to seek it out in the forgotten hallway where it stood motionless, forgotten… and untouched. The young elf priestess couldn’t resist her lascivious thoughts any longer, a hand reaching out to caress the statue oh so intimately. But what’s this? Suddenly the golem is coming to stony rigid life – right in her hand! What happens next is sexy, wild and oh so satisfying to a young elven magical girl seeking new adventures!
